svg.title: Runs that finish, with proof
svg.desc: Every step is journaled. After a crash the run resumes where it stopped; finished steps are never re-run. Then it’s signed.
svg.text: Every step is journaled. After a crash the run resumes where it stopped; finished steps are never re-run. Then it’s signed.

g.text: — lock expired, recovery sweep reclaims the run —
edit one journal row and it fails
